description: This file defines a static class XFontStyles providing predefined font style properties and mapping functionality within the PdfSharp.Drawing namespace, related to font styling in PDF rendering.

classes.name: XFontStyles
classes.description: A static class providing predefined font style properties and a method to convert style strings to XFontStyle instances.

methods.name: XFontStyles.Normal
methods.description: Returns an XFontStyle representing the normal font style.

methods.name: XFontStyles.Oblique
methods.description: Returns an XFontStyle representing the oblique font style.

methods.name: XFontStyles.Italic
methods.description: Returns an XFontStyle representing the italic font style.

methods.name: XFontStyles.XFontStyleStringToKnownStyle
methods.description: Converts a string representation of style to an XFontStyle instance, returning true if successful.
